text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Is this a new lipstick from your line?
Think I'll try
it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's not my product, just something I did an ad for. It's a tint with a half matte finish. Thought it'd suit your tastes.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whooa... But what if you want a super
glossy
look? ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, maybe this new product
would work
for you, Falco. It's
waterproof, which means it
won't sweat
off. And it stands out from
afar—that's a
plus if you're on stage.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so all this makeup has City's mark
of
approv'l? Wear'n these'll make me
more like a
city girl?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yukino's eyes are so sparkly! ♪ I want to
sparkle
like that, too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
City, I need you to make us super duper
cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You know, Curren, I really admire how
you can
do that so effortlessly. Makes
me jealous.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But sure, I'll find something. What kind
of
occasion do you two want lipstick for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume continue to fill the
cosmetic
shop with their lively chatter.
